var list = [];
var base = baseUrl;
if (/fiction/.test(base)) {
book.type = 8;
list = java.getElements('.chapter-container@a||.title');
}
else if (/comic/.test(base)) {
book.type = 64;
list = java.getElements('.chapters@a');
}
else if (/photo/.test(base)||/amateur/.test(base)) {
book.type = 64;
var lastPage = java.getString(".pager@a.-2@text");
if (lastPage) {
var max = parseInt(lastPage);
if (isNaN(max)) max = 1;
var basePath = base.replace(/\.html$/, "");
for (let i = 1; i <= max; i++) {
list.push({
text: i,
href: basePath + "/" + i + ".html"
});
}
}
else{ 				
list.push({text: "正文", href: base});
}
} 
else if (/video/.test(base)) {
book.type = 8;
list=[{text: "视频", href: base}];
}
list
</js>
